summary: No actionable correctness blocker found in batched high-order mTHP swap-in for zswap. Allowing orders up to order 4 when all slots in the aligned range reside in zswap eliminates repeated PTL acquisitions and fault overhead. Decompressing each compressed slot into subpage i of the compound folio and installing with set_ptes under a single PTL hold preserves folio and slot lifetimes, cgroup and vmstat accounting, and fault concurrency semantics.
